name: io.github.techsociety75-blip/agent-data-hub
title: Agent Data Hub
description: 176 data tools for agents: web scraping, JSON-LD, RAG/BM25, ABI decode, storage slots, KYB, DeFi

tools.name: sanctions_screen
tools.description: Screen a person or company name against official sanctions lists (OFAC SDN, OFAC Consolidated, UN Security Council) with fuzzy name matching and aliases. Returns scored potential matches with list, programs and remarks. Lists refreshed every 6 hours. Price: $0.05 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

name.description: Person or organisation name to screen

tools.name: sanctions_wallet
tools.description: Check whether a crypto wallet address (BTC, ETH/EVM, TRON, etc.) appears on the OFAC sanctions list of digital currency addresses. Exact match, case-insensitive for EVM. Price: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: company_lei
tools.description: Look up a legal entity by LEI code or by name via GLEIF: legal name, jurisdiction, legal & HQ address, entity status, registration status, BIC codes, and direct/ultimate parent companies. Price: $0.01 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

country.description: Optional ISO-2 country filter for name search

tools.name: company_vat
tools.description: Validate an EU VAT number in real time against the official EU VIES service and return the registered business name and address where the member state provides them. Price: $0.01 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

vat.description: VAT number, with or without country prefix, e.g. DE811907980

tools.name: company_registry
tools.description: Search official government company registries by name or registry number: France (INSEE SIRENE — status, creation date, activity, directors) and Norway (Brønnøysund — status, industry, employees, website). Price: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: company_sec
tools.description: Profile of a US SEC-registered company by ticker, CIK or name: legal name, tickers, exchanges, industry (SIC), state of incorporation, fiscal year end, address, former names and the 15 most recent filings with direct links. Price: $0.01 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: company_sec_summary
tools.description: Structured digest of a company's latest SEC filing (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, S-1…): summary, business overview, financial-highlight sentences quoted verbatim from the filing, key risk sentences and notable events. Every sentence comes from the filing itself — nothing is invented. Cached per filing. Price: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: finance_iban
tools.description: Validate an IBAN for 85+ countries: format, country length and mod-97 checksum. Returns formatted IBAN, country, SEPA membership and BBAN. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: domain_company
tools.description: Turn a website domain into company information: name, legal name, description, logo, founding date, address, language and official social profiles (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, GitHub…), from the site's structured data and HTML. Price: $0.03 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: domain_contacts
tools.description: Find the public business contact details a company publishes on its own website: emails (flagged role/on-domain), phone numbers, contact pages and social links. Scans the homepage plus up to 3 contact/about pages. Price: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: domain_tech
tools.description: Detect the technologies a website uses: ecommerce platform, CMS, frontend framework, analytics, payments, support chat, marketing tools, CDN, hosting and server — 60+ signatures, grouped by category. Price: $0.01 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: domain_trust
tools.description: Risk signals for a domain: registration age and registrar (RDAP), TLS certificate validity and expiry, MX/SPF/DMARC email security, with a 0–100 trust score and plain-language warnings. Useful for fraud, phishing and vendor checks. Price: $0.005 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Check an email address without contacting the mailbox: syntax, domain MX records, disposable/temporary provider (120k+ domains), role account and free-provider flags, with a deliverability verdict. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: page_text
tools.description: Fetch any public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (ads, menus and boilerplate removed) with title, byline, language and word count. Ideal for feeding pages to LLMs. Price: $0.003 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

url.description: Full URL of the web page, e.g. https://example.com/page

tools.name: page_product
tools.description: Extract structured product data from any product page: name, brand, SKU/GTIN, price, currency, availability, condition, rating, review count and image (schema.org JSON-LD with meta fallbacks). Price: $0.005 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

url.description: Full URL of the web page, e.g. https://example.com/page

tools.name: page_summary
tools.description: Summarize any web page or article: summary built from the page's own most important sentences, key points, topics, content type and language. Fast and deterministic. length = short | medium | long. Price: $0.005 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

url.description: Full URL of the web page, e.g. https://example.com/page

tools.name: page_tables
tools.description: Extract every HTML table on a page as structured JSON records (headers, rows, captions). Up to 20 tables, 500 rows each. Price: $0.005 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

url.description: Full URL of the web page, e.g. https://example.com/page

tools.name: page_info
tools.description: Fast metadata for any URL: HTTP status, title, description, language, canonical URL, favicon, Open Graph, Twitter card, H1/H2 headings, link and image counts, and structured-data types. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

url.description: Full URL of the web page, e.g. https://example.com/page

tools.name: page_ai_permission
tools.description: Check whether a site allows AI bots to read a URL: robots.txt rules for 20 AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot…), noai meta/X-Robots-Tag opt-outs, and llms.txt / ai.txt presence. Check before scraping. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

url.description: Full URL of the web page, e.g. https://example.com/page

tools.name: calendar_business_days
tools.description: Public holidays and working days for 200+ countries (with regional rules and local weekends, e.g. Fri–Sat in Saudi Arabia). Modes: list a year's holidays; count business days between start and end; or add N business days to a date. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, GB, DE, AE

region.description: Optional state/region code, e.g. CA for US-CA

end.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD — counts business days in range

add.description: Integer — add N business days to start

tools.name: crypto_price
tools.description: Current USD price for up to 20 crypto tokens in one call: by symbol (btc, eth, sol, usdc…), CoinGecko id, or contract address (base:0x…, ethereum:0x…, solana:<mint>). Returns price_usd, symbol, decimals, confidence and update time. Aggregated DEX/CEX prices via DefiLlama, cached 30s. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: chain_balance
tools.description: Live wallet balance on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Gnosis or Base Sepolia: native coin (ETH/POL/BNB…) plus USDC by default, or up to 5 ERC-20 tokens you name. Returns human-readable and raw amounts, symbols and the block number read. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

token.description: Optional: up to 5 ERC-20 contract addresses, comma-separated, or 'usdc'

tools.name: chain_token
tools.description: Read an ERC-20 token contract on any major EVM chain: name, symbol, decimals and total supply (human-readable and raw). Errors (not charged) if the address is not a token contract. Use to verify a token before trading or paying. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: chain_tx
tools.description: Look up an EVM transaction by hash: pending/success/failed, confirmations, timestamp, from/to, value, fee paid, method id, and decoded ERC-20 Transfer events (token, amount, from, to). Chains: Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Gnosis. Use to confirm a payment landed. Price: $0.003 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: chain_gas
tools.description: Current gas price, base fee and suggested priority fee (gwei) plus the cost of a simple transfer in native coin, for one chain or 'all' (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC) in one call. Cached 10s. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

chain.description: Chain name, comma-separated list, or 'all' (default all)

tools.name: chain_block_number
tools.description: Latest block number, block hash, timestamp, age in seconds and tx count for one EVM chain or several at once (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Gnosis, Base Sepolia; 'all' = 6 main chains). Use as a chain-head / liveness check or to anchor block ranges. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

chain.description: Chain name, comma-separated list, or 'all' (default all)

tools.name: chain_nonce
tools.description: Transaction count (nonce) of an address on any major EVM chain: confirmed nonce, pending nonce, number of stuck/pending transactions and the next nonce to use, plus whether the address is a contract. Use before signing a transaction or to detect a stuck wallet. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: chain_contract
tools.description: Inspect any EVM address: wallet (EOA), EIP-7702 delegated wallet, or contract. For contracts: detected standard (ERC-20 / ERC-721 / ERC-1155 / ERC-165), name, symbol, decimals and total supply for tokens, proxy type (EIP-1967, beacon, EIP-1167 clone) with implementation address, owner(), bytecode size and code hash. Use to check what you are about to interact with. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: chain_ens
tools.description: Resolve an ENS name to its Ethereum address (plus avatar record), or an address to its primary ENS name (reverse lookup). Live from Ethereum mainnet via the ENS Universal Resolver, cached 5 minutes. Pass 'name' or 'address'. 404 (not charged) when the name has no address. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

address.description: Or an address 0x… for reverse lookup

tools.name: chain_erc20_transfers
tools.description: Recent ERC-20 Transfer events from the last N blocks (1–2000, default 500) for a token contract, a wallet (incoming + outgoing, any token), or both. Returns newest first: block, tx hash, token, symbol, from, to, human amount, raw amount and in/out direction for wallets. Use to see if a payment arrived or watch token flows. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: chain_erc20_balance
tools.description: One token balance for one wallet, live from the chain: pass the wallet and the ERC-20 contract (or 'usdc'). Returns human-readable balance, raw amount, symbol, name, decimals and the block read. Chains: Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Gnosis, Base Sepolia. 422 (not charged) if the address is not a token. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: chain_live_balance
tools.description: Native coin balance (ETH, POL, BNB, AVAX, xDAI) of an address read live from the chain, on one chain or 6 main chains at once (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC) in a single call. Returns per-chain balance, raw wei, block, and the list of chains where the balance is non-zero. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

chain.description: Chain name, comma-separated list, or 'all' (default all)

tools.name: chain_total_supply
tools.description: Current total supply of an ERC-20 token, read live: human-readable and raw, with symbol, name, decimals and block number. Pass the token contract (or 'usdc'). Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Gnosis. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: chain_block
tools.description: Read one EVM block: number, hash, parent hash, timestamp, age, miner/proposer, transaction count, gas used/limit and utilization %, base fee (gwei) and size. Pass a block number, a 0x block hash, or latest/finalized/safe. 404 (not charged) if the block does not exist yet. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

number.description: Block number, 0x block hash, or latest / finalized / safe (default latest)

tools.name: chain_network_info
tools.description: Network facts for one or several EVM chains in one call: chain id, name, native currency, testnet flag, latest block and its age, average block time (last 100 blocks), gas price and base fee (gwei), block explorer URL and the native USDC contract. 'all' = Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

chain.description: Chain name, comma-separated list, or 'all' (default all)

tools.name: chain_allowance
tools.description: How much of a token a spender (router, contract, x402 facilitator) is approved to move from an owner: allowance (or 'unlimited'), raw amount, whether any approval exists, the owner's balance and the amount spendable right now (min of both). Use before transferFrom/swaps, or to audit risky unlimited approvals. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: chain_logs
tools.description: Recent event logs emitted by a contract over the last N blocks (1–2000, default 100), newest first. Pass an event signature such as 'Swap(address indexed sender, uint256 amount0In, …)' to filter AND decode args by name, or a raw topic0 to filter only. Returns block, tx hash, log index, topics, data and decoded args. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

event.description: Optional Solidity event signature to filter + decode

topic0.description: Optional raw topic0 (0x + 64 hex) instead of event

tools.name: net_dns
tools.description: Live DNS lookup for a domain: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA and CAA records (pick types or 'all'), plus an email-security summary: SPF record, DMARC record and policy, and a plain verdict (spoofable or not). Errors (not charged) for invalid or non-existent domains. Use to verify a domain, check mail setup, or spot phishing risk. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: net_ssl
tools.description: Connect to a host and inspect its TLS certificate: trusted or not (with the error), hostname match, issuer, subject, SAN domains, valid from/to, days left, expires-soon flag, SHA-256 fingerprint, key type, TLS protocol and cipher, and the issuer chain. Use to monitor certificate expiry or check if a site is safe to call. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: util_hash
tools.description: Hash text or bytes with md5, sha1, sha256, sha512, sha3-256, keccak256 (Ethereum) and crc32 — one algorithm, a list, or all at once. Input as UTF-8 text, hex or base64. Returns lowercase hex digests (keccak256 with 0x). Deterministic; up to 100,000 characters. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

text.description: Text to hash (or hex/base64, see input_encoding)

algorithm.description: md5, sha1, sha256, sha512, sha3-256, keccak256, crc32, a comma list, or 'all' (default all)

tools.name: util_encode
tools.description: Encode or decode text: base64, base64url, hex, URL percent-encoding, HTML entities. Decoding binary data returns is_utf8=false plus the hex bytes instead of broken text. Invalid input returns a 400 error (not charged). Up to 100,000 characters. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: util_uuid
tools.description: Generate 1–100 cryptographically random UUIDs, version 4 (random) or version 7 (time-ordered, sortable, RFC 9562). Or pass 'validate' to check a UUID: valid format, version, and the embedded timestamp for v7. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

validate.description: Optional: a UUID to validate/parse instead of generating

tools.name: util_time
tools.description: Accurate current time (or a given ISO/unix time) as UTC ISO, unix seconds and ms, ISO week, day of year, plus local date/time, UTC offset, abbreviation and weekday in up to 20 IANA time zones (e.g. Asia/Dubai, America/New_York). DST-correct. Use when an agent needs the real date/time or to convert between zones. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tz.description: Comma-separated IANA time zones, e.g. Asia/Dubai,America/New_York (optional)

at.description: Optional time to convert: ISO 8601 or unix seconds/ms (default now)

tools.name: util_random
tools.description: Cryptographically secure randomness (CSPRNG): integers in [min,max], floats, random bytes (hex + base64), pick from a list, shuffle a list, strong passwords, coin flips or dice rolls (up to 1000 values). Use when an agent needs unbiased randomness it cannot produce itself. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

type.description: int (default), float, bytes, pick, shuffle, password, coin, dice

max.description: Maximum (int default 100, float default 1; dice: sides, default 6)

length.description: Bytes length (1–1024, default 32) or password length (8–128, default 20)

tools.name: util_ip
tools.description: Returns the caller's public IP address (or checks the IP you pass): IPv4/IPv6 version, type (public, private, CGNAT, loopback, link-local, documentation, multicast, reserved), IPv4-mapped detection and reverse DNS (PTR) hostname. Use to learn your own egress IP or validate an IP before using it. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

ip.description: Optional IP to check (default: your own IP)

tools.name: fx_convert
tools.description: Convert an amount between 300+ currencies: all ISO fiat currencies plus major crypto (BTC, ETH, USDC…). Daily mid-market rate, latest or any date since 2024-03-02. Returns rate, converted result, rate date and currency names. Indicative rates, not for trading. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

date.description: Optional date YYYY-MM-DD for a historical rate (since 2024-03-02)

tools.name: fx_rates
tools.description: Daily exchange rates from one base currency to 300+ fiat and crypto currencies, latest or for a date since 2024-03-02. Optionally limit to a comma-separated list of symbols. Indicative mid-market rates, not for trading. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: ref_country
tools.description: Look up a country by ISO 3166 alpha-2, alpha-3, numeric code or name. Returns ISO codes, official name, capital, region and sub-region, continent, currency (ISO 4217), international calling code, internet TLD, languages and flag emoji. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

country.description: ISO code (AE, ARE, 784) or country name

tools.name: geo_airport
tools.description: Find large and medium airports (4,800+ worldwide) by IATA or ICAO code, or search by city or airport name, optionally within one country. Returns IATA, ICAO, name, city, country, region, coordinates, elevation, size and whether it has scheduled flights. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

query.description: City or airport name, e.g. London

country.description: Optional country filter (ISO code or name)

tools.name: geo_distance
tools.description: Distance between two points given as airport codes (IATA/ICAO) or 'lat,lon'. Returns kilometres, miles, nautical miles and the initial compass bearing (great-circle / haversine). Useful for flight distance, travel and logistics estimates. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: validate_phone
tools.description: Validate and normalise any phone number worldwide (Google libphonenumber metadata). Returns valid/possible, line type (mobile, fixed line, toll free, VoIP…), E.164, international and national format, country and calling code. Pass a country code for numbers written in national format. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

country.description: Optional default country (ISO code) for national-format numbers

tools.name: finance_bic
tools.description: Check a SWIFT/BIC code (ISO 9362): format, 8 vs 11 characters, bank code, country (with name), location and branch code, test and passive-participant flags. Format and country check only; it does not confirm the code is registered with SWIFT. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: search_wikipedia
tools.description: Full-text search of Wikipedia in any language. Returns ranked articles (title, URL, clean snippet, word count, last edit) plus a plain-text intro summary of the top hit, so one call usually answers 'what is X'. Use for fact lookup, entity disambiguation and grounding answers with a citable source. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

lang.description: Wikipedia language code (default en), e.g. de, fr, ar

tools.name: search_hackernews
tools.description: Search Hacker News stories or comments by keyword, ranked by relevance or newest first, optionally only the last N days. Returns title, linked URL, HN discussion URL, author, points, comment count and date. Use for tech news, launch reactions, developer sentiment and trend research. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

days.description: Only items from the last N days (optional)

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search academic papers, preprints and books across all fields (OpenAlex index of 250M+ works). Returns title, year, authors, venue, DOI, citation count, open-access PDF link and abstract text. Filter by year range or open access; sort by relevance, citations or newest. Use for literature review, citations and research grounding. Price: $0.003 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. retrieval augmented generation

tools.name: ref_doi
tools.description: Resolve a DOI to full citation metadata (title, authors, journal, publisher, date, volume/issue/pages, ISSN, license, citation count, abstract when available), or find works by a free-text reference string. Use to verify citations, build bibliographies or check that a paper an LLM cited really exists. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

query.description: Or a free-text reference/title to search

tools.name: validate_security_id
tools.description: Validate a securities or entity identifier and auto-detect its type: ISIN (12), CUSIP (9), SEDOL (7) or LEI (20). Returns valid true/false, the expected check digit, the parts (country, issuer, LOU prefix) and conversions (CUSIP→US ISIN, SEDOL→GB ISIN, ISIN→embedded CUSIP/SEDOL). Use before trading, KYC or data matching to catch typos. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

type.description: Optional: isin, cusip, sedol or lei (auto-detected by length)

tools.name: web_accessibility_audit
tools.description: Check one public web page for accessibility problems against WCAG 2.2 AA: missing image alt text, unlabeled form fields, empty links/buttons, blocked zoom, missing page language/title, heading order, iframes without titles, positive tabindex, focusable aria-hidden content, autoplay media, invalid ARIA roles and more. Returns a 0-100 score, grade, issues grouped by impact (critical/serious/moderate/minor) with WCAG criterion, example HTML and a fix-guide link, plus the rules that passed. Static HTML analysis: colour contrast and JavaScript-built content are listed as not_checked. For EAA/ADA compliance checks. Price: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

url.description: Full URL of the web page, e.g. https://example.com/page

tools.name: web_accessibility_crawl
tools.description: Audit a website's start page plus up to 9 same-site pages it links to (robots.txt respected) against WCAG 2.2 AA in one call. Returns the site score (0-100), the worst page, the top issues across the site (how many pages each affects, WCAG criterion, fix-guide link) and a per-page score with issue counts. Same static checks as /v1/web/accessibility-audit. Use it for EU Accessibility Act or ADA website reviews and lead qualification. Price: $0.10 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

url.description: Full URL of the web page, e.g. https://example.com/page

tools.name: crypto_defi_tvl
tools.description: Total value locked (TVL) for DeFi protocols. Look up one protocol by name/slug (aave, uniswap, lido…) or rank the top protocols, optionally filtered by chain (TVL on that chain) and category (Dexs, Lending, Liquid Staking, Bridge, CDP, Yield, Derivatives, RWA…). Returns tvl_usd, 1d/7d change %, category, chains, top chains by TVL, market cap, website. DefiLlama data, cached 10 min. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

protocol.description: Optional protocol name or slug, e.g. aave, uniswap, lido

chain.description: Optional chain name, e.g. Ethereum, Base, Solana, Arbitrum

category.description: Optional category, e.g. Lending, Dexs, Liquid Staking

tools.name: crypto_chain_tvl
tools.description: DeFi total value locked per blockchain: rank, TVL in USD, share of all DeFi TVL, native token symbol and chain id. Ask for the top N chains or specific chains (comma-separated names or chain ids). DefiLlama data, cached 10 min. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

chain.description: Optional: comma-separated chain names or ids, e.g. Ethereum,Base,Solana or 8453

limit.description: Top N chains when no chain given, 1-100 (default 20)

tools.name: crypto_yields
tools.description: Find the highest DeFi yields across 15,000+ pools: filter by token symbol (USDC, ETH, stETH…), chain, project, stablecoins only and minimum TVL (default $1M); sort by current APY, 30-day mean APY or TVL. Each pool returns project, chain, symbol, tvl_usd, apy (base + reward split), 30-day mean APY, 7-day APY change, impermanent-loss risk, exposure and DefiLlama's trend prediction. Outliers removed. Cached 15 min. Not investment advice. Price: $0.003 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

token.description: Optional token symbol in the pool, e.g. USDC, ETH

chain.description: Optional chain, e.g. Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum

tools.name: crypto_price_history
tools.description: Historical USD prices for one token: hourly, 4-hourly, daily or weekly points for the last 1-365 days (max 500 points). Give price_start + price_end or price_change_pct. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

price_start.description: Price of token A when you deposited

price_end.description: Price of token A now / at exit

price_change_pct.description: Instead of prices: % change of token A (e.g. 100 = doubled, -50 = halved)

fees_earned_pct.description: Trading fees earned over the period, % of deposit (default 0)

tools.name: crypto_position_size
tools.description: Risk-based position sizing for a crypto (or any) trade: from account size, risk % and entry/stop it returns units to buy/sell, notional, margin needed at your leverage, estimated isolated-margin liquidation price and whether the stop is hit before liquidation, plus reward and risk:reward if you give a take-profit. Optional round-trip fee %. Side is inferred from the stop. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

account_size.description: Account equity in USD (or quote currency)

risk_pct.description: % of account to risk on this trade, e.g. 1

side.description: long or short (default: inferred from stop)

tools.name: crypto_apy
tools.description: Convert APR to APY or APY to APR for any compounding (daily, weekly, monthly, hourly, per-block, continuous or N per year) — the number DeFi/staking/savings pages mix up. Returns both rates, daily rate, doubling time, and (with principal + days) the projected value and earnings. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

compounding.description: daily (default), weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly, hourly, block, continuous or a number per year

tools.name: chain_siwe
tools.description: Build a correct EIP-4361 SIWE message for wallet login (EIP-55 address, chain id, nonce, issued/expiry times, statement, resources) ready for personal_sign — or parse an existing SIWE message into fields and check format, checksum, nonce length, expiry/notBefore and expected domain. Pair with /v1/chain/verify-signature to check the signature. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

nonce.description: Build: random nonce (≥8 letters/digits) that your server issued

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche, bsc or chain id

message.description: Parse mode: an existing SIWE message

tools.name: chain_merkle_tree
tools.description: Build a Merkle tree for an allowlist or airdrop (up to 10,000 rows): addresses, or address + amount, or any ABI types. Returns the root to put in your contract and each row's leaf + proof, byte-for-byte compatible with OpenZeppelin StandardMerkleTree and MerkleProof.verify (double-keccak leaves, sorted pairs). Use 'prove' to get one address's proof. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

values.description: One address per line, 'address,amount' per line, or JSON rows [["0x…","1000"]]

types.description: ABI types per column (default address, or address,uint256 for 2 columns)

prove.description: Optional: only return the proof for this address/value

tools.name: page_extract
tools.description: Structured scraping in one call: give a URL (we fetch it, robots-safe, cached) or HTML you already have, plus a map of field name → CSS selector. Returns JSON with each field's text, or an attribute with 'selector@attr' (links and images made absolute), or all matches with '[]'. Also returns match counts and which fields found nothing, so the agent can fix selectors. Example selectors: {"title":"h1","price":".price","links":"a@href[]"}. Price: $0.003 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

url.description: Page URL to fetch (or give html)

html.description: HTML you already have (instead of url)

selectors.description: JSON object: field name → CSS selector; 'sel@attr' for an attribute; add [] for all matches

base_url.description: With html: base URL to make links absolute

tools.name: email_parse
tools.description: Turn raw email source (RFC 5322 + MIME, as from Gmail 'show original', IMAP or an inbound webhook) into clean JSON: subject (encoded words decoded), from/reply-to/to/cc as name + email, ISO date, message-id/in-reply-to/references for threading, plain text body (HTML converted when there is no text part; quoted-printable/base64 and charsets decoded), links, attachment list (name, type, size), List-Unsubscribe and SPF/DKIM/DMARC results. Attachment contents are not returned. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: calendar_parse_ics
tools.description: Read iCalendar (.ics) text — a meeting invite, a calendar export or a subscribed feed — into JSON events sorted by time: title, start/end as given plus converted to UTC (TZID and all-day handled, DURATION applied), recurrence rule, location, description, organizer, attendees with RSVP status, Zoom/Google Meet/Teams link found, alarm. Up to 2,000 events. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: util_token_count
tools.description: Estimate how many LLM tokens a text uses before you send it (BPE-style estimate that GPT, Claude and Llama tokenizers match within ~15% on normal text; CJK and non-Latin scripts handled). Optional: context_limit + reserve_output_tokens → does it fit and how many tokens are left; price_per_million → cost in USD; chunk_tokens → how many chunks to split into. Returns tokens_estimate, low/high range, characters, words, chars_per_token. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

reserve_output_tokens.description: Tokens to keep free for the answer (optional)

tools.name: util_text_similarity
tools.description: Score how similar two texts are (0–1) and get a verdict: near_duplicate, very_similar, related, loosely_related or different. Combines term cosine, word Jaccard, character trigrams and edit similarity (texts ≤3,000 chars). Also lists shared terms and terms only in A or only in B — useful for dedupe, plagiarism/copy checks, answer grading and change detection. Lexical, deterministic, no embeddings. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: util_bm25_rank
tools.description: Keyword search over documents you supply, no index needed: give a query and up to 2,000 documents (strings or {id,title,text}) and get them ranked by Okapi BM25 with score, relative relevance, matched terms, query coverage and a best-matching snippet. Use for RAG retrieval, reranking search results or picking the right FAQ/chunk before calling an LLM. Tunable k1/b, top_k. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

documents.description: JSON array of strings or {id,title,text} objects (≤2000)

tools.name: util_summarize_text
tools.description: Extractive summary of text you already have (article, transcript, email thread, document): returns the N most central sentences copied verbatim in original order (TextRank), each with a score, plus top keywords and compression stats. Deterministic, no hallucination, instant — good for cutting long context before an LLM call. For a URL use /v1/page/summary. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: security_html_sanitize
tools.description: Clean HTML from users, LLM output, emails or scraped pages before you show or store it. Drops script/style/iframe/object/form/svg and similar, strips every on* handler and style attribute, removes javascript:/data:/vbscript: URLs, unwraps unknown tags (keeps their text) and adds rel=nofollow to external links. Modes: basic (rich text, tables, images), strict (simple formatting + links), text (plain text only). Reports what was removed and was_clean. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: page_structured_data
tools.description: Get the machine-readable data a page publishes, from a URL (fetched robots-safe, cached) or HTML you have: every JSON-LD block (@graph flattened), OpenGraph/article/product meta, Twitter card meta, schema.org microdata items with nested properties, plus title, description, canonical and language, and the list of schema types found (Product, Article, Recipe, Event, Organization, FAQPage…). Ideal for product, price, review, recipe and event extraction and for SEO audits. Price: $0.003 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

url.description: Page URL (or give html)

base_url.description: With html: base URL for absolute links

tools.name: validate_vin
tools.description: Check a 17-character Vehicle Identification Number offline: format (no I/O/Q), NHTSA check digit (mandatory in North America, flagged elsewhere), WMI → manufacturer for ~90 common makes, region and country, model year (A–Y/1–9 cycle resolved with the North-American position-7 rule), plant code and serial. Use for car marketplaces, insurance, fleet and logistics forms. Structural decode only — no owner data. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: crypto_perp_calc
tools.description: For a long or short USDT/USDC-margined perp (isolated): give entry, leverage and size (quantity, margin or notional) and get notional, initial margin, liquidation price, distance to liquidation, breakeven price after round-trip fees, PnL per 1% move. Add exit (+ hours_held and funding_rate_pct per 8h) for gross/net PnL, fees, funding paid, ROE and whether it would have been liquidated first. Maintenance margin and fee bps adjustable (defaults 0.5% / 5 bps). Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

fee_bps.description: Taker fee per side in bps (default 5)

tools.name: chain_gas_cost
tools.description: Turn gas into money exactly (wei-precise): give gas units or an action preset (eth_transfer, erc20_transfer, erc20_approve, uniswap_v2_swap, uniswap_v3_swap, nft_mint, nft_transfer, safe_multisig_exec, contract_deploy_small), base fee and priority fee in gwei, optional max fee, optional L2 L1-data fee and native token price → fee in wei/gwei/native/USD, burned vs tip, worst-case cost at max fee and transactions per $1. Pair with /v1/chain/gas for live fees. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

l1_fee_eth.description: L2 only: L1 data fee in ETH (optional)

tools.name: chain_abi_decode
tools.description: Turn raw hex from eth_call / a contract read / event data into typed values. Give the output types ('uint112,uint112,uint32', tuples and arrays like '(address,uint256)[]' supported) or a signature with a returns part ('getReserves() returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 ts)'). Returns each value with its type and name (big integers as exact decimal strings, addresses checksummed) plus a name→value map. Offline, any EVM chain. Errors are 400 (not charged). Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

data.description: ABI-encoded hex bytes (0x…), e.g. an eth_call result

types.description: Comma-separated Solidity types, e.g. uint256,address,bool or (address,uint256)[]

signature.description: Alternative to types: function signature with returns (…)

tools.name: chain_storage_slot
tools.description: Find the exact storage slot to read with eth_getStorageAt: mapping[key] (nested up to 8 levels: keys='owner,spender'), dynamic array element (keccak(slot)+index×size), ERC-7201 namespaced storage (OpenZeppelin v5 upgradeable contracts) or the EIP-1967 proxy implementation/admin/beacon slots (kind=proxy). Key types are inferred (address, uint256, bytes32, string) or set with key_types. Use to read balances/allowances directly from storage, inspect proxies or verify storage layouts. Offline. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

kind.description: mapping, array, erc7201 or proxy (auto-detected from the other params)

slot.description: Base slot number of the mapping/array variable (default 0)

keys.description: Mapping key(s), comma-separated for nested mappings

key_types.description: Optional key types, comma-separated (address, uint256, bytes32, string…)

tools.name: chain_encode_packed
tools.description: Reproduce Solidity hashing exactly: abi.encodePacked(types, values) and its keccak256 (signature digests, Merkle leaves, CREATE2 salts, mapping keys), the same values with abi.encode + keccak256, and/or the keccak256 and EIP-191 personal_sign hash of a message. Types as a comma list or JSON array (address, uint8–uint256, int*, bool, bytes1–32, bytes, string); values as a comma list or JSON array. Offline. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

types.description: Solidity types, comma-separated or JSON array

values.description: Values in the same order, comma-separated or JSON array

message.description: Optional text to hash as keccak256 and EIP-191 personal_sign

tools.name: util_text_case
tools.description: Split any text into words (handles camelCase, acronyms like HTTPResponse, accents, punctuation) and return it as URL slug, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, CONSTANT_CASE, kebab-case, dot.case, Title Case (small words kept lower), Sentence case, UPPER and lower. Accents are folded in slugs (é→e). Optional to= limits the output, max_length trims the slug on a word boundary. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

to.description: Optional: comma list of cases to return (slug,camel,pascal,snake,constant,kebab,dot,title,sentence,upper,lower)

tools.name: util_number_to_words
tools.description: Write a number in English words exactly (up to 36 digits, decimals read digit by digit): 1234 → 'one thousand two hundred thirty-four', ordinal ('forty-second', '42nd'), roman numerals (1–3999, and roman → number), and with currency= the amount in words for invoices and cheques ('One thousand two hundred thirty-four dollars and fifty-six cents', '… and 56/100 only'). Currencies: USD, EUR, GBP, AED, SAR, INR, PKR, CAD, AUD, CHF, JPY, CNY, USDC. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

number.description: Number like 1234.56 (or a roman numeral like MMXXVI)

currency.description: Optional currency code for amount-in-words, e.g. USD, AED, EUR

tools.name: util_number_format
tools.description: Format a number the way people in a locale expect (Unicode CLDR / ICU): currency (€1,234.50 vs 1.234,50 €, Indian lakh grouping 12,34,567), accounting negatives, percent, compact (1.2M / 1.2 million), scientific/engineering, and units (km/h, GB, °C). Up to 10 locales per call, each with its decimal and group separator. Use for invoices, reports and user-facing replies in the user's own format. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

style.description: decimal, currency, accounting, percent, compact, scientific, engineering or unit

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for currency/accounting, e.g. EUR

unit.description: For style=unit, e.g. kilometer-per-hour, gigabyte, celsius

tools.name: util_base_convert
tools.description: Exact conversion of arbitrarily large integers (BigInt, up to 2000 digits) between any base 2–36, base58 (Bitcoin alphabet) and base62. Auto-detects 0x / 0b / 0o prefixes. Returns all requested bases plus bit length, byte length and the value as a 0x-prefixed and 32-byte padded hex word (for uint256 / EVM use). Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: geo_sun
tools.description: For a latitude/longitude and date: sunrise, sunset, solar noon, civil/nautical/astronomical dawn and dusk, golden hour, day length and the sun's highest altitude — in UTC and (with tz) local time. Handles polar day/night (state field, nulls for events that do not happen). Accuracy ±1–2 minutes. Use for scheduling, photography, prayer-time inputs, solar and outdoor planning. Offline. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tz.description: IANA time zone for local times, e.g. Asia/Dubai (optional)

tools.name: geo_moon
tools.description: Moon phase for a date or time: phase name (new, waxing crescent, first quarter, … waning crescent), illuminated fraction %, age in days, waxing/waning, Earth–Moon distance, and the next full moon and new moon times in UTC (Meeus algorithm, ±2 min). Use for calendars (Islamic/Hebrew/Chinese month starts, Ramadan planning inputs), fishing, astronomy and events. Offline. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (noon UTC) or ISO date-time (default now)

tools.name: chain_receipt
tools.description: Receipt of a mined EVM transaction: success or reverted, block, confirmations, from/to, contract created, gas used, effective gas price, total fee in native coin, log count, and decoded ERC-20 / ERC-721 Transfer events (token, from, to, amount or token id). 404 (not charged) when the hash is unknown or still pending. tools.name: chain_call
tools.description: Call any view/pure function on any EVM contract and get the decoded result. Pass the Solidity signature (e.g. 'balanceOf(address) returns (uint256)' or 'getReserves() returns (uint112 r0, uint112 r1, uint32 ts)') and args as a JSON array or comma list; optional historical block. Returns decoded values (named when outputs are named), selector and raw hex. Read-only: never sends a transaction. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: chain_code
tools.description: Deployed bytecode of an address on any major EVM chain: is it a contract, bytecode size, keccak code hash, EIP-7702 delegate (smart wallet) or EIP-1167 minimal-proxy target if any, and the function selectors found in the dispatcher. tools.name: chain_estimate_gas

Use before sending a transfer, swap or contract call. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: chain_nft_owner
tools.description: Current owner of an ERC-721 NFT by contract + token id on any major EVM chain, with the collection name and symbol. 422 (not charged) when the token does not exist or the contract is not ERC-721. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: chain_nft_metadata
tools.description: Metadata of an NFT read live from the chain: token URI (tokenURI or ERC-1155 uri), resolved IPFS/Arweave/https/data: metadata JSON with name, description, image URL (IPFS resolved to a gateway) and attributes/traits, plus collection name and current owner. tools.name: chain_nft_balance

tools.description: Balance of a wallet for one or up to 50 ERC-1155 token ids in one call (balanceOf per id), which ids it actually holds, and the collection's uri template. tools.name: chain_pending

Use to pick a priority fee or watch for big incoming transfers. Price: $0.004 per call (USDC on Base via x402); the first 10 calls per day are free.

tools.name: crypto_slippage
tools.description: Walk the live order book to price a market buy or sell before you trade: pass size (base units) or quote_amount (e.g. USD).
